notes.title: Small update to improve loading times and frame rate
notes.content:
This update improves the loading time at the beginning of the game as well as should improve the frame rate on non-capped Graphics cards.

If you are still seeing slow loading times, it is recommended that you turn off the V-Sync on your monitor as that will bottleneck the loading of assets into memory.

Thanks,
M.P.

notes.title: Some "mini-updates" since launch...
notes.content:
Due to feedback from awesome players, we have fixed a few things to add a better gaming experience:

- Fixed bug when attempting to use torch in hand on an empty inventory slot. It no longer crashes

- Removed ESC key bind to game play that went to title screen since some users accidentally hit it and lost game before saving

- Removed ESC hotkey from the title screen to exit game to prevent accidents. Player must now click Exit button to end game now

- ESC key in game play mode now toggles a pause screen with options for New Game, Load Game, Return to Game, or Exit  (while in pause mode, your torch doesn't burn down)

Have fun and happy adventuring!
Matthew, David, and Tori (Team Templum)
